Task: Quenching of Copper
Description: Simulate the quenching process of Copper using LAMMPS by cooling its molten structure under NPT conditions, followed by relaxation under NPT and NVT conditions. messages.content:
The LAMMPS simulation ran successfully this time. The final volume of the system after the NVT relaxation is 6354.1325 Å³.

To calculate the density, we need the mass of the system. Since we have 500 copper atoms and the atomic mass of copper is approximately 63.546 g/mol, we can calculate the total mass and then the density.

1. Calculate the total mass of the system:
   \[
   \text{Total mass} = 500 \times 63.546 \, \text{g/mol} \times \frac{1}{6.022 \times 10^{23} \, \text{atoms/mol}} = 5.274 \times 10^{-22} \, \text{g}
   \]

2. Convert the volume from Å³ to cm³:
   \[
   \text{Volume in cm}^3 = 6354.1325 \, \text{Å}^3 \times \left(\frac{1 \, \text{cm}}{10^8 \, \text{Å}}\right)^3 = 6.3541325 \times 10^{-21} \, \text{cm}^3
   \]

3. Calculate the density:
   \[
   \text{Density} = \frac{\text{Total mass}}{\text{Volume in cm}^3} = \frac{5.274 \times 10^{-22} \, \text{g}}{6.3541325 \times 10^{-21} \, \text{cm}^3} = 8.30 \, \text{g/cm}^3
   \]

Final Answer: 8.30
